DroppedClaim.title: DroppedClaim
DroppedClaim.description: A model claim whose quote was not found in the fetched page. Logged here, never shown as evidence.

Interpretation.title: Interpretation
Interpretation.description: One reading of a vague site, offered as a click; never a required text box.

OutreachEmail.title: OutreachEmail
OutreachEmail.description: A cold email for a Shortlisted company, drafted on request from quotes the skeptic supported.

Overrides-Input.title: Overrides
Overrides-Input.description: Optional corrections merged on top of what the agent inferred. None is required.

Overrides-Output.title: Overrides
Overrides-Output.description: Optional corrections merged on top of what the agent inferred. None is required.

PageSignature.title: PageSignature
PageSignature.description:
Compact code-level observations of one fetched page, kept so competitors added later can be checked
without fetching again.

Pitch.title: Pitch
Pitch.description: Why now and an opening line for a Shortlisted company, written only from quotes the skeptic supported.

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: Exact words from a fetched page: location text means the readable page, html means the page's own code.

SellerDescription-Input.title: SellerDescription
SellerDescription-Input.description:
A seller without a website describes its business in its own words. The description stands in for the site:
every claim about the seller quotes these words, labelled as your description, so nothing is made up.

StatedLimit.title: StatedLimit
StatedLimit.description: Served size or region, only when the seller's own site states it.
